name: Split Arrow Shafts

flavor_text: You bend and weave the reeds into a basket.

name: Forge Ambren Foraging Knife
flavor_text: You draw out a slim blade for cutting stems.

name: Cut Granite Block
flavor_text: You dress the granite square with chisel and mallet.

name: Build Fence Panel
flavor_text: You nail rail to post, and a length of fence takes shape.

name: Hammer Ambren Nails
flavor_text: You cut, draw, and head one nail after another.

name: Forge Ambren Hoe
flavor_text: You hammer out the broad blade of a hoe.

name: Thresh Grain Sheaves
flavor_text: You beat the grain free of the straw.

name: Mill Flour
flavor_text: You turn the quern, grinding the grain to flour.

name: Ret Flax
flavor_text: You weight the flax under still water and leave it to rot.

name: Scutch Flax
flavor_text: You beat and comb the flax until the fibre comes free.

name: Spin Linen Thread
flavor_text: You draw the flax fibre out and twist it into thread.

name: Weave Linen Cloth
flavor_text: You work the loom, and the linen grows row by row.

name: Gather Straw
flavor_text: You bundle the loose straw and tie it off.

name: Raise a Bucket
flavor_text: You set the staves in a ring and bind them tight.

name: Lanai Mallet
flavor_text: You shape the mallet head and drive the haft home.

name: Build Feed Pail
flavor_text: You set the staves, drive the band home, and the pail holds water on the first try.

name: Build Mucking Fork
flavor_text: Four tines, a long haft, and a job nobody thanks you for.

name: Stitch Halter & Lead
flavor_text: Plait, buckle, and a lead long enough to give a nervous animal some room.

name: Tan Cowhide
flavor_text: The hide goes under the liquor and the vat is left to do the slow work.

name: Forge Ambren Butchering Knife
flavor_text: You beat out a wide blade and put a long curve on the edge.

name: Churn Butter
flavor_text: You work the plunger until the milk gives up and turns.

name: Press Cheese
flavor_text: You break the curd, pack the mould, and lean on the press.

name: Stitch Leather Foraging Gloves
flavor_text: You cut, stitch and turn them, and the seams end up on the inside where they belong.

name: Stitch Leather Boots
flavor_text: Sole, upper, and a great deal of waxed thread. They will outlast the roads.

name: Cut Leather Strips
flavor_text: You run the knife down the hide in one long turn, and the coil drops away.

name: Forge Ambren Hooks
flavor_text: You draw the wire fine, turn the shank, and file the barb to a point.

name: Assemble Ambren Fishing Rod
flavor_text: You whip the line down the pole and seat the hook at its end.

name: Weave Fishing Net
flavor_text: You knot the linen row upon row until the mesh sits true.

name: Granite Mortar and Pestle
flavor_text: You are hollowing out a bowl of granite.

name: Ambren Meat Cleaver

name: Ambren Flesh Hook

name: Forge Ambren Spear
flavor_text: You draw out a leaf-shaped head and seat it on the shaft.

name: Forge Ambren Scimitar
flavor_text: You hammer a long curve into the blade and grind the edge.

name: Forge Ambren Mace
flavor_text: You weld six flanges round a heavy head.

name: Forge Ambren Daggers
flavor_text: You forge two slim blades from one bar and match them by weight.

name: Forge Ambren Hand Axes
flavor_text: You punch two eyes and fit two short hafts.

name: Forge Ambren War Hammers
flavor_text: You square two faces and draw a spike from the back of each.

name: Forge Ambren Atgeir
flavor_text: You forge a broad head, turn a spur off one side, and socket it on a long haft.

name: Forge Ambren Greatsword
flavor_text: You draw the blade out a hand at a time and keep it straight.

name: Forge Ambren Maul
flavor_text: You upset a heavy block and drift a wide eye through it.

name: Forge Ambren Bracers
flavor_text: You shape two curved plates and punch holes for the laces.

name: Forge Ambren Boots
flavor_text: You rivet thin plates over toe and shin.

name: Forge Ambren Coif
flavor_text: You close ring after ring until the hood holds its shape.

name: Forge Ambren Buckler
flavor_text: You dish a round plate and rivet a grip behind the boss.

name: Forge Ambren Chausses
flavor_text: You link two long sleeves of rings and lace them to a belt.

name: Forge Ambren Hauberk
flavor_text: You close the rings over a leather backing, row by row.

name: Forge Ambren Gauntlets
flavor_text: You fit small plates to each finger and rivet the joints loose.

name: Forge Ambren Sabatons
flavor_text: You overlap the lames and rivet them so the foot can bend.

name: Forge Ambren Helm
flavor_text: You raise a bowl from a flat plate and draw a nasal down the front.

name: Forge Ambren Kite Shield
flavor_text: You shape a long tapering plate and strap leather behind it.

name: Forge Ambren Greaves
flavor_text: You curve each plate to a leg and set the knee cops.

name: Forge Ambren Cuirass
flavor_text: You raise breast and back plates and buckle them over a leather jack.

name: Forge Ambren Gem Chisel
flavor_text: You draw a short chisel out to a fine edge and fit it to a handle.

name: Build Lap Wheel
flavor_text: You true a wheel on its spindle and set ground granite into its face.

name: Refine Quartz
flavor_text: You hold the quartz to the turning wheel and grind away the dull skin, a little at a time.

name: Refine Garnet
flavor_text: You set the garnet to the wheel and feel for the grain before you take the first face.

name: String a Hunting Bow
flavor_text: You shave a Lanai stave to an even bend and string it with twisted linen.

name: Forge Ambren Jeweller's Pliers
flavor_text: You draw two short arms of Ambren, rivet them, and file the jaws until they meet.

name: Sew Wolfskin Cloak
flavor_text: You lay the pelts out in rows, match the grain of the fur, and stitch them together edge to edge.

flavor_text: You turn the wheel true on its axle and fit the flyer that will draw the thread.

name: Build Loom
flavor_text: You square the frame, hang the heddles and set the beam that will take the cloth.
